description: Understand concepts of university learning expectations and student responsibilities, including Session I. Effective Learning Skills, College culture and expectations.
Apply effective study and memory strategies, including Studying, memory, Test taking, Studying.
Identify test-taking strategies used in academic assessments, including Information Literacy, Group Project Part : Presentation & Final report of group project.

Plan academic goals and manage study time effectively, including Time Management Skills, Time Management in College, How to Manage Time, Prioritization: Self-Management of What You Do, When You Do It, Enhanced Strategies for Time and.
Implement strategies to manage academic stress and maintain well-being, including Time Management Skills, Enhanced Strategies for Time and.

Demonstrate effective communication in academic contexts, including An Overview of Communication, Barriers to Effective Communication, Group Project Part : Presentation & Final report of group project.
Utilize digital learning tools and online learning strategies, including Learning to Learn Online, Who am I as an online learner?, Who am I on my learning journey with?.

Practice responsible and ethical use of AI in academic work, including Ethics of Using AI in Higher Education, Its Impact on Academic Integrity, Ethical Challenges of Using AI in Higher Education, Ethical Concerns About Biases, Surveillance in AI Algorithms, Academic Integrity in Higher Education Under the Lens of AI, Impact on Academic Integrity Due to Efficacy of AI Detection, Impact on Academic Integrity Due to Human Biases Generated By AI tools.
Evaluate the credibility of academic information sources, including How to use AI to Help, Not Hinder, Your Learning, Group Project Part : Presentation & Final report of group project.

Apply thinking skills to analyze learning problems using critical or creative approaches, including Session III. Thinking Skills for the Digital Age, What thinking means, Analytical Thinking, Creative thinking, Critical thinking.

Integrate academic skills in practical learning tasks or project work, including Part1 Project, Ethics of Using AI in Higher Education and Its Impact on Academic Integrity, Academic Integrity in Higher Education Under the Lens of AI, Impact on Academic Integrity Due to Efficacy of AI Detection Tools, Impact on Academic Integrity Due to Human Biases Generated By AI tools, How to use AI to Help, Not Hinder, Your Learning.
